video.title: Microsoft Copilot Cowork Created My Presentation in Minutes!

transcript.text: This is one of the few AI features that
actually saved me time. So, I gave
Microsoft Copilot Co-work one simple
task to turn these project notes into a
PowerPoint presentation. Normally, I
would read through everything, figure
out what goes on each slide, and then
>> [music]
>> build the presentation myself. But, this
time Co-work handled everything
[clears throat] step-by-step. It
reviewed the notes, pulled out key
points, created a slide outline, and
even generated the first draft for me
all step-by-step. [music] And that's
where I think AI is heading. We are
moving from AI that can simply answer
questions to AI that can [music]
actually complete tasks. Try out Co-work
today. Open up the Copilot app and
select Co-work on top left. Subscribe
for more AI tools and tutorials.
